n: Turnstile Mount Bracket for Face Recognition Terminal
d: The Dahua ASF053-ZJ is an aluminum alloy turnstile mounting bracket designed for Dahua face recognition access terminals. It provides a secure and angled mounting solution for turnstile installations and is compatible with multiple Dahua ASI series face recognition terminals.

specs.label: Applicable Product Model
specs.value: Supports various series such as ASI62xxS, ASI72xxS, ASI7213K, ASI82xxS, and ASI8213SA
